# Bonwire Kente - Authentic Ghanaian Kente Cloth

> Bonwire Kente is an online store for authentic, handwoven Ghanaian Kente cloth, fabrics, and custom-printed products. Products ship from Bonwire, the Ashanti heritage village where Kente weaving began in the 17th century.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://bonwirekente.vercel.app/): Shop overview, trending products, and promotions
- [All Products](https://bonwirekente.vercel.app/products): Browse the full Kente catalog with search, filters, and categories
- [AI Try-On](https://bonwirekente.vercel.app/ai-tryon): Virtual garment try-on for custom Kente designs
- [Kente Museum](https://bonwirekente.vercel.app/museum): History, patterns, and cultural significance of Kente weaving
- [Stores](https://bonwirekente.vercel.app/vendors): Approved Kente weaving communities and sellers
- [About Us](https://bonwirekente.vercel.app/aboutus): Company story and heritage commitment
- [Help](https://bonwirekente.vercel.app/help): FAQ, shipping, returns, and customer support
- [Suggestions](https://bonwirekente.vercel.app/suggestions): Submit feature ideas and improvements

## Optional

- Bonwire is a village in the Ashanti Region, Ghana. Kente cloth is woven on hand looms using colorful strips of silk and cotton, with each pattern carrying cultural meaning.
- The store supports secure mobile money and card payments, and every piece is made to order (slow fashion).
